brief:
Political consultant Peter Feld characterized Democratic divisions over Israel as a "death match" between the party establishment and its progressive wing, according to Mondoweiss. He analyzed recent primary contests where pro-Israel advocacy group AIPAC experienced both electoral victories and defeats, alongside attacks on progressive commentator Hasan Piker, suggesting the party faces internal fracturing on Middle East policy heading into the midterm elections.

Feld pointed to Democratic demoralization among progressives and simultaneous Republican organizational weakness as factors that could produce unpredictable electoral outcomes in November. Israel-related disputes are reshaping Democratic primary dynamics as the midterm cycle moves forward.
dek: Political consultant Peter Feld breaks down the primaries, AIPAC’s losses (and wins), the attacks on Hasan Piker, and why a demoralized GOP and Democratic infighting could both shape the midterms in unexpected ways.
title: Democratic infighting over Israel policy intensifies ahead of midterms
